description: This file defines the Maintenance controller class for the OpenCart catalog system. It handles the display of the maintenance page when the site is in maintenance mode, setting appropriate HTTP headers, preparing view data, and rendering the maintenance view.

classes.name: Maintenance
classes.description: Controller class responsible for rendering the maintenance page, setting HTTP headers, and preparing view data.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method that prepares and outputs the maintenance page, including setting headers and loading view components.
